column7: A retention purge below a signed checkpoint broke verification and checkpointing (#3257). The fix credits chained events removed by sanctioned purges via a cumulative purged count HMAC-signed into the retention anchor (v2, same transaction as the DELETE); checkpoints certify chained + purged. This row pins the security side: an inflated purged count fails the anchor signature and earns no credit, so a truncation cannot be passed off as a purge.
